topic: Merchant email now available on the ThemeSale object in the Partners API
caption:
Theme developers can now access purchasing merchant email addresses directly on the ThemeSale object in the Partners API.

This update removes friction when connecting with buyers. Instead of manual lookups, developers can build automated workflows in Next.js backend services to sync buyer data and route support inquiries immediately after purchase.

To implement this, query the new email field within your Partners API calls and pass the payload securely to your CRM or custom tooling. Ensure your database handling respects standard merchant identifiers alongside the new contact point.

A critical caveat remains. Shopify explicitly reminds builders that handling this data must strictly comply with all applicable privacy and marketing laws under the Partner Program Agreement.

Builders should audit their onboarding flows to utilize direct buyer contact data while rigorously enforcing data minimization and consent standards.
